title: Timeline MVP
description: Timeline panel: layers (add/delete/reorder, show/hide, lock), keyframes and frame spans, playhead scrubbing, insert frame (F5)/keyframe (F6)/blank keyframe (F7), frame labels. Playback controls (play/stop, loop). Single scene for MVP; scene panel deferred. See docs/02-timeline-and-animation.md. Depends on document-model-mvp, authoring-ui-shell-mvp.
